reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, linking Al content to short-range ordering and lattice distortions, which are well-established factors in HEAs, though the direct, quantitative link to all four properties simultaneously is ambitious and has notable gaps.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, specifying a systematic composition series, key characterization techniques (synchrotron/EXAFS), and a decisive falsification criterion based on the correlation between Al content and SRO.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is highly useful as it proposes a single, testable mechanistic driver (Al-Ni SRO) for multiple critical properties, directly addressing the research question and guiding a focused experimental program.
